plan.title: Auth hardening: token expiry + throttled auth routes

tasks.description: H1: Enable Sanctum bearer-token expiration — set config/sanctum.php 'expiration' to (int) env('SANCTUM_EXPIRATION_MINUTES', 1440); register daily schedule routes/console.php ->command('sanctum:prune-expired --hours=24')->daily(); document the fixed 24h-from-login behavior (no refresh; existing 401 redirect handles it) in config comments.

H2: Add named rate limiters in AppServiceProvider::boot() — RateLimiter::for('login', perMinute(5)->by(email.'|'.ip()) + perMinute(20)->by(ip())) and RateLimiter::for('register', perMinute(5)->by(ip())); apply ->middleware('throttle:login') and ->middleware('throttle:register') to POST /api/login and POST /api/register in routes/api.php (EXACTLY one argument each). Also document in/bootstrap/app.php that the api group has no default throttle.

Feature tests covering both fixes: (a) expired-token test — real createToken() bearer header (NEVER Sanctum::actingAs), travel 1441 minutes, assert 401 on GET /api/user with JSON message; (b) throttle tests — 6 rapid bad logins assert 429 on the 6th, travel 61s then assert 422 resumes; fresh array cache per test. Dependent: 1.1, 1.2.

plan.title: Auth hardening: token expiry + throttled auth routes

tasks.description: H1: Enable Sanctum bearer-token expiration — config/sanctum.php: 'expiration' => max(1, (int) env('SANCTUM_EXPIRATION_MINUTES', 1440)) (fails closed: empty env can't disable expiry); add SANCTUM_EXPIRATION_MINUTES=1440 to .env.example; document fixed 24h-from-login semantics in config comments. Add scheduled pruning in routes/console.php: Schedule::command('sanctum:prune-expired --hours=24')->daily() (with Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule import) + a comment noting it needs host cron (schedule:run) and is housekeeping only — the guard enforces expiry regardless.

H2: Named rate limiters in AppServiceProvider::boot() — RateLimiter::for('login', fn) = Limit::perMinute(5)->by(strtolower((string) $request->input('email')).'|'.$request->ip()) plus Limit::perMinute(20)->by($request->ip()); RateLimiter::for('register', perMinute(5)->by(ip())) (string cast avoids pre-validation TypeError on array input). Routes: POST /api/login ->middleware('throttle:login'); POST /api/register ->middleware('throttle:register'); EXACTLY one argument each.

TEST task (depends 1.1): tests/Feature/TokenExpirationTest.php — test class USES RefreshDatabase (phpunit.xml uses :memory: sqlite; no such table otherwise); build user via User::factory(); issue token with $user->createToken('api')->plainTextToken + $this->withHeader('Authorization', "Bearer $token") — NEVER Sanctum::actingAs (TransientToken bypasses expiry); $this->travel(1441)->minutes() then GET /api/user asserts 401 with JSON message 'Unauthenticated.'; also assert pre-travel 200 sanity. Verify: php artisan test --filter=TokenExpirationTest.

TEST task (depends 1.2): tests/Feature/AuthRateLimitTest.php — test class USES RefreshDatabase; phpunit.xml sets CACHE_STORE=array (fresh per test). Post 6 rapid bad-credential login requests (same email+IP); assert response #6 (and any beyond) is 429; $this->travel(61)->seconds(); next bad login asserts 422 resumes (ArrayStore uses test time so travel decays the bucket). Also one register-side assertion: 6 rapid POST /api/register -> 429. Verify: php artisan test --filter=AuthRateLimitTest.
